events.headline: Definitive Centrus fuel contracts
events.fact: Oklo signed multiyear HALEU supply agreements covering fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses; deliveries from the Ohio plant are scheduled to start in 2029.

impacts.title: Fuel procurement becomes more concrete
impacts.implication: Definitive supply arrangements reduce procurement uncertainty; the delivery schedule, fabrication and project financing remain execution gates.

impacts.title: Fuel sourcing supports the thesis
impacts.implication: A binding fuel supply agreement is stronger evidence than a letter of intent; it is not delivered fuel or an operating license.

assessment.reason: Definitive fuel supply contracts strengthen the fuel-procurement condition, not commercial readiness as a whole.

impacts.title: Fuel procurement and financing
impacts.implication: Fuel availability improves but contractual purchases may require funding. Payment amounts and their effect on project runway are not quantified; retain reported cash and burn figures.

events.headline: Expanded supplier capacity commitments
events.fact: NVIDIA announced further substrate and packaging capacity agreements, including multibillion-dollar support for SPIL and capacity expected to increase by mid-2029.

impacts.title: Supply expansion supports production capacity
impacts.implication: Long-dated supply access could ease production constraints; contracted capacity is not realized sales.

impacts.title: Supplier commitments and prepayments
impacts.implication: Capacity security trades off against future commitments and capital at risk if customer demand disappoints. The incremental payment schedule is unquantified.

assessment.reason: New multiyear supplier funding and commitments merit monitoring until timing and exposure are reconciled to filings.

impacts.title: Supplier funding and cash conversion
impacts.implication: Prepayments and supplier funding may affect future cash conversion; do not treat them as reported capex or add them to previously disclosed obligations without reconciliation.

impacts.title: Demand and capacity alignment
impacts.implication: Long-dated capacity increases the importance of matching supply with realized customer demand; it does not establish inventory impairment.

events.headline: AWS–Minfy collaboration extended to 2031
events.fact: Minfy and AWS announced a five-year worldwide collaboration covering industry-specific AI solutions, with a target three times the previous agreement.

impacts.title: Partner-led AWS demand
impacts.implication: The expanded scope supports enterprise AI adoption through partners, but commercial targets are not guaranteed AWS revenue or RPO.

impacts.title: AWS demand evidence
impacts.implication: Additional partner-channel activity is consistent with expanding demand; financial scale is not disclosed and sustained growth still requires reported evidence.

events.headline: Google Cloud publishes TPU and GPU training benchmarks
events.fact: Google Cloud released MLPerf results for Ironwood TPUs and NVIDIA Blackwell accelerators across training workloads.

impacts.title: Custom silicon capability
impacts.implication: A broader accelerator portfolio can improve customer choice and differentiation; benchmark results alone do not establish revenue growth or unit economics.

impacts.title: Customer-owned accelerator alternatives
impacts.implication: Google's own TPU development illustrates substitution risk while Blackwell availability also indicates ongoing NVIDIA ecosystem participation. No lost orders are established.

impacts.title: Competing cloud accelerator portfolio
impacts.implication: Google's TPU and GPU portfolio reinforces competition in AI infrastructure; evaluate AWS Trainium demand and workload-level economics rather than infer market-share loss.

catalysts.headline: October brokerage metrics
catalysts.fact: Interactive Brokers reported year-over-year account and margin loan growth alongside lower trading activity.
catalysts.assessment: Customer acquisition remains strong. Trading activity is lagging account growth.

catalysts.headline: Fed kept rates unchanged
catalysts.fact: Two members preferred raising the target range by a quarter percentage point.
catalysts.assessment: The unchanged rate supports a relatively stable near-term interest income backdrop, subject to client balances and funding costs.

catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results
catalysts.fact: Interactive Brokers reported diluted earnings of $0.69 per share for Q3.
catalysts.assessment: Earnings rose year over year. Watch whether customer growth translates into sustained trading revenue.

catalysts.headline: Q3 operating results
catalysts.fact: Net deposits were $15.7 billion, down from $20.4 billion in the year-earlier quarter.
catalysts.assessment: Funded-customer and Gold growth support franchise expansion, while net deposits slowed year over year.

catalysts.headline: Q3 results and book-to-bill
catalysts.fact: Kratos reported a 2.2× consolidated book-to-bill ratio and a $4.9 million operating loss.
catalysts.assessment: Orders outpaced billings. Follow delivery timing and margins as the backlog converts to revenue.

catalysts.headline: AWS–Minfy collaboration extended to 2031
catalysts.fact: Minfy and AWS announced a five-year worldwide collaboration covering industry-specific AI solutions, with a target three times the previous agreement.
catalysts.assessment: The partnership supports demand for AWS AI infrastructure. Its impact on capacity needs and returns is unquantified.
